notes: Total market value as TSETMC publishes it, converted from rials to toman. It is not a return: it rises and falls with listings, delistings and share issues as well as with prices — on 2025-03-26 the bourse's value rose 9.14% while TEDPIX rose 0.93%. Use the index for what the market returned.
The dollar figure divides each session's value by the free-market dollar rate in force that day (USD_IRT, carried forward, never backward).

data_age.note: Tehran market data does not refresh itself: TSETMC is unreachable from the production host, so indices, market value and money flow arrive only when an operator runs the fetch from a network that can reach it. This is the age of the newest stored session, measured against today.
